usageNotes: Use this to register a new OpenID Connect realm in Proxmox Datacenter Manager so users can authenticate via an external identity provider (e.g., Keycloak, Azure AD, Authentik). Requires the `Realm.Allocate` privilege on `/access/domains`. The `realm` name must be unique across all authentication realms; if `autocreate` is false (default), users must be pre-provisioned in PDM before they can log in via the new realm.

examples.summary: Register an Authentik-backed OIDC realm for SSO

tips: The `username-claim` field determines how PDM maps OIDC token claims to local user accounts — ensure the IdP cannot let users self-modify this claim, as it is the uniqueness key.
Scopes default to 'email profile'; add 'openid' explicitly if your IdP requires it in the scope list.
Set `default: true` only after verifying the realm works correctly; an unreachable default IdP locks out web-UI users who rely on automatic realm pre-selection.
After creation, verify the realm appears with `get_config_access` or `get_config_access_openid_{realm}` before directing users to log in.
